## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes (added/updated tests for new logic)
- [ ] Production build works (`node esbuild.js --production`)
- [ ] No user text passed through a shell; no text logged; no telemetry/network added
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior/config changed (README / CAMBIOS / TECHNICAL_DECISIONS)
